principle: Advanced coverage never compensates for a foundational gap; repairs are true-owner, append-only or explicitly superseding, and the zero count is valid only for the effective post-repair curriculum.

gaps.title: Counting, cardinality and base-ten place value
gaps.closure_note: Counting/cardinality, numeral/place-value, zero placeholder, compose/decompose and compare/order are explicit in foundational C02 claims/objectives.

gaps.title: Whole-number and decimal arithmetic fluency, strategies and written methods
gaps.closure_note: Operation meanings, mental strategies, whole-number written algorithms, terminating-decimal written methods and estimation/reasonableness are explicit.

gaps.title: Concrete-to-formal fractions and decimal place-value progression
gaps.closure_note: Unit/part-whole/quotient/measure/operator meanings, number line, equivalence, improper/mixed, decimal place value and fraction-decimal-percent connections are explicit.

gaps.title: Patterns, equality, unknowns and early algebraic generalisation
gaps.closure_note: Repeating/growing patterns, equality-as-relation, unknowns, contextual equations, arithmetic generalisation and table/graph/formula progression are explicit.

gaps.title: Everyday measurement and unit reasoning
gaps.closure_note: Pre-unit comparison, unit/scale reading, multiplicative conversion, time/timetable, money/unit-price, affine temperature boundary, unit choice and magnitude estimation are explicit; physical metrology stays B1.2.

gaps.title: Elementary 2-D/3-D shape and spatial reasoning
gaps.closure_note: Common 2-D/3-D classification, components, compose/decompose, turns, reference-frame spatial language, coordinates, transformations, nets and simple views are explicit before advanced geometry.

gaps.title: Data collection, simple displays and graphical literacy
gaps.closure_note: Question framing, observational recording, classification/counting, frequency/tally, pictogram/bar/line/pie displays, axes/scales/legends, pattern description and display choice are explicit; acquisition systems remain B1.5.

gaps.title: Chance language and experimental-to-formal probability progression
gaps.closure_note: Pre-numerical qualitative chance language, 0-1 scale, finite equally-likely models, repeated experiments, relative-frequency variation and experimental-vs-theoretical distinction are explicit.

gaps.title: Common-spine mathematical problem solving and modelling cycle
gaps.closure_note: Simple context-to-model-to-interpretation cycle plus units/bounds/magnitude/constraint checks and model revision now has a foundational entry path independent of C05/C06 specialist prerequisites.

next_action: Director integration audit plus fresh Backup Sentinel TREE_ALIGNMENT_PASS; no B1.2 unlock before both pass.
